description: Trust framework for Government Digital Services (GovTech) and Digital Identity systems in Sub-Saharan Africa, focusing on inclusion, data privacy, service reliability, and anti-corruption.
context_notes: Digital Identity is the foundational layer for the digital economy in Africa (KYC, Social Protection, Voting). However, centralized ID systems raise massive privacy and surveillance concerns. e-Government portals aim to reduce corruption and improve efficiency, but often suffer from downtime and exclusion of the poor/elderly who lack digital skills or devices.
risk_factors: Vendor Lock-in (foreign sovereign control of ID data)
